title: A morphism with affine source is separated
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $X$ affine, i.e. isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ for a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism].
